Data + reporting (team dashboard, lead source tracking, conversion metrics)

A) GoHighLevel Admin (Core)

Ensure website leads flow into the correct pipeline with proper tags/source fields

Improve trust signals (process, FAQ, “free service” explanation, credibility cues)

C) Reporting + Analytics

Build and maintain the Team Dashboard inside GHL

Track: lead volume, lead sources, tours requested/booked, apps submitted, approvals (as available), pacing vs weekly targets

Spot bottlenecks and recommend system fixes

Ensure the team scoreboard + dashboard data matches (no broken tracking)

D) Systems Operator + Mindset (Strategist Partner)

Proactively identify what’s messy and fix it

Write short SOPs or training notes when changes are made

Improve execution quality by simplifying processes

Communicate clearly with leadership and the team

What Success Looks Like (30 Days)

Website is complete and live, with clear CTA + form routing

GHL pipelines/tags are clean and consistent across the team

Team dashboard is accurate and shows weekly pacing at a glance

Lead sources are tracked properly (FB/IG/TikTok/CL/Website)

Reduced dropped leads + improved follow-up discipline through automation + reporting

Requirements (Must-Have)

Strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (not just “familiar”)

Can build/modify workflows, pipelines, forms, calendars, triggers

Comfortable building web pages inside GHL

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Can think like an operator: systems, structure, accountability

Strong written English (clear and professional)

Nice-to-Have

Experience with real estate CRMs, appointment-setting systems, or lead gen operations

Understanding of funnels/landing pages and conversion basics

Ability to create simple dashboards/spreadsheets if needed

Experience documenting SOPs and training materials

Work Style + Expectations

You are proactive and don’t need hand-holding

You give clear updates and progress summaries

You follow instructions, but you also improve the system intelligently

You’re comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment with high standards

Schedule + Pay

Part-time or full-time depending on fit

Pay based on experience (we are willing to pay for true skill and reliability)

Performance-based growth available

To Apply (Required)



Send:



Your GoHighLevel experience summary (specific examples of what you built)

A Loom walkthrough of a GHL account you’ve worked in (pipelines + workflows)

Answer: “If leads are going stale in a pipeline, what are 3 system changes you’d implement to prevent it?”

Educational (the customer should learn something on the page)

Warm and considered (not cold-clinical, not influencer-bro)

Premium but accessible (think kinder, gentler version of Lume; not Sephora-luxury)

Logistics

title: Part-Time Sales Development Representative - B2B/GHL
description:
Company Overview

 

Reference:
LevelUp is a specialized agency that provides premium outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with diverse organizations, delivering valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We boast a large team of skilled, passionate professionals who are dedicated to producing high-quality work for our clients.

 

Position Overview

 

LevelUp is seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) for a crucial part-time role focused on fueling our sales pipeline. This position involves working directly with the founder to scale the sales and marketing side of the business. The role demands a proactive, self-starter attitude and a comfort level with testing various outbound outreach methods, including cold calls,
s, social selling, and WhatsApp messaging. The SDR will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective clients, serving as the initial point of contact to build strong rapport. A key focus of this role will be closing low-ticket deals and smoothly transitioning larger, qualified leads to the founder. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication skills, a robust work ethic, resilience, and a coachable attitude, all while remaining eager to learn and contribute to our growth within a dynamic startup environment.

 



Responsibilities

•Leverage the GoHighLevel platform to identify, prospect, and generate a high volume of qualified leads.

•Conduct proactive outbound outreach to potential clients via cold calling,
 campaigns, and other creative channels.

•Clearly articulate the value proposition of our SaaS products to prospects and effectively overcome objections.

•Qualify leads and book appointments or conduct product demonstrations on behalf of the founder.

•Manage the full sales cycle for low-ticket deals, from initial contact through to finalizing the sale.

•Maintain an accurate and up-to-date record of all sales activities and lead statuses within our CRM.

•Consistently meet and strive to exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets.

•Collaborate with the founder to ensure a seamless client onboarding experience and to refine ongoing sales strategies.



Requirements

•Must-Have: Minimum of 2+ years of sales experience, complete with a proven track record in successfully closing deals.

•Must-Have: Demonstrable experience in high-ticket sales, even if your primary past roles involved low-ticket items.

•Must-Have: A proactive and self-starter mentality, comfortable working autonomously, setting priorities, and testing new outreach strategies in an environment with limited existing SOPs.

•Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

•Strong resilience and a proven ability to handle objections and rejection gracefully.

•Highly motivated, results-driven, and open to coaching.

•Comfortable with a Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) setup.

•Nice-to-Have: Experience selling SaaS products, particularly those related to paid marketing.

•Nice-to-Have: Familiarity and hands-on experience with the GoHighLevel platform.



More Information

•This is a fully remote, part-time position.

•The work schedule is often a night shift to align with UK hours (approximately 7 PM - 11 PM PH time).

•We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its tea
mbers, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment.

title: Founder’s Executive Assistant / AI + Ecommerce Operations Assistant
description:
I'm looking for a sharp, reliable virtual assistant to help me stay organized across personal admin, scheduling, inbox triage, simple research, follow-ups, and day-to-day operations.



I am a serial entrepreneur and founder. I have built and scaled multiple businesses from zero to tens of millions in revenue, across software, ecommerce, and other operating companies. My work now sits at the intersection of technology, AI, investing, and consumer brands. I also run one of the top-selling fashion brands on TikTok, so the day-to-day can include a mix of founder support, ecommerce operations, research, AI tools, messages, scheduling, and personal/admin logistics.



I am looking for someone who is genuinely curious and excited to be close to fast-moving work. This is not just a basic task-completion role. It starts part-time, but for the right person, there is real room for this to become long-term and grow into more responsibility over time. As trust builds, I would want you to take on more execution, manage follow-through more independently, help build systems, and eventually own larger parts of my personal and business operations.



The best fit is someone who is calm, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working with a founder/owner who moves quickly and has many parallel projects.



Core responsibilities:

- Organize and summarize inbox items, messages, reminders, and follow-ups

- Help prepare a simple daily brief with schedule items, urgent issues, and next actions

- Do light research, compare options, and turn messy information into clear recommendations

- Draft short messages, checklists, SOPs, and simple status updates

- Track tasks and make sure nothing important slips through the cracks

- Help with calendar coordination, appointment prep, and personal admin

- Keep notes clean, structured, and easy to act on

- Gradually take on more execution and ownership as trust builds



You may be a great fit if you:

- Write clearly in English and can summarize information without overcomplicating it

- Have strong judgment about what is urgent, what can wait, and what needs clarification

- Are curious about startups, ecommerce, fashion, AI, technology, and how modern companies grow

- Are comfortable asking concise questions when something is unclear

- Can handle sensitive personal or business context with discretion

- Are organized enough to maintain recurring routines without needing constant reminders

- Are comfortable using tools like Google Docs, Google Sheets, Gmail, Slack, task systems, and AI tools

- Enjoy making another person's life feel calmer and more under control



Nice to have:

- Experience supporting a founder, executive, entrepreneur, or busy family

- Experience with inbox management, scheduling, operations, recruiting, ecommerce, or research

- Comfort creating simple SOPs and improving repeatable workflows

- Interest in learning how AI tools can improve operations and everyday work



How to apply:

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. A short summary of your VA or executive assistant experience

2. The tools you are strongest with

3. One example of how you helped someone get more organized

4. Why this kind of role sounds interesting to you

5. Your preferred working hours in Philippine time

6. Your expected hourly rate



I care more about judgment, reliability, curiosity, and clear communication than a perfect resume.

title: Controlled Chaos Studios social media and editor expert
description:
# Social Media + Content Editor — Controlled Chaos Studios



**Hiring:** Part-time (10–15 hrs/week to start, scope to grow)

**Location:** Remote (must overlap 2–3 hrs with AEST/AEDT business hours)

**Engagement:** 1-month paid trial ? ongoing monthly retainer

**Reports to:** Joshua Ward, Founder



-----



## About us



Controlled Chaos Studios (CCS) is a Melbourne-based video production company. Our craft sits in **cinematic storytelling, high-end videography, and colour grading** — we shoot athletes, events, and documentary work for clients like Hockey Victoria, Basketball Australia, and NBL1 South, but the social channel isn’t about scores and game recaps. It’s about the **look, the feel, and the process** behind what we make.



We’re on the ground at training sessions, finals, podcast tapings, and shoots — and most of the best stories are in what happens around the camera, not just in front of it.



We produce a lot of footage. We don’t post nearly enough of it. That’s where you come in.



## The role



You’ll take the BTS footage, finished cinematic work, and podcast recordings I produce and turn them into a consistent, high-quality social presence across **Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts**.



**The focus is the craft, not the scoreboard.** I want the channel to show off the storytelling, the cinematography, the colour, the gear, the locations, and the team behind the work — broadcast-style highlights and game recaps are not what we’re building here.



You’re not a strategist I’m hiring to invent the brand. You’re an operator with strong creative instincts who can run the engine — and grow it — once you understand the voice.



## What you’ll actually do



- **Edit cinematic short-form video** — Reels, TikToks, Shorts built around BTS clips, slow-motion cuts, colour-graded sequences, and “how it was made” storytelling. Cuts to music, captions, hook in the first 1.5 seconds. The look should feel premium, not template-y.

- **Cut podcast edits** — repurpose long-form podcast recordings into short clips (60–90 sec), full episode video edits, audiograms, and quote graphics for social.

- **Build carousels** — multi-slide image posts for shoot recaps, location reveals, gear breakdowns, before/after colour grade comparisons, and “day in the life on set” storytelling.

- **Schedule and post daily** — across IG, TikTok, LinkedIn (and YouTube Shorts when relevant). Maintain a 7-day content calendar I can see and approve.

- **Write captions** in CCS voice — punchy, confident, not corporate, occasional dry humour. Australian spelling.

- **Community management** — reply to comments and DMs, flag anything that needs my attention (club enquiries, partnership requests, athlete tags).

- **Monthly performance report** — what worked, what didn’t, what to try next. No vanity metrics.

- **Paid ads (when needed)** — boost posts, run small Meta and TikTok campaigns for specific shoots, partnerships, or service offerings. Budget management, audience setup, basic reporting.



## What I need from you



**Required:**



- 2+ years editing short-form video for social in **DaVinci Resolve** (we share project files — CapCut and Premiere editors won’t work for this role)

- **Strong cinematic eye** — pacing, music selection, respect for nice footage. You can recognise good colour and won’t crush a graded shot with a CapCut LUT.

- **Podcast editing experience** — comfortable cutting long-form video podcasts into short-form clips, audiograms, and full episode edits with chapter markers

- Carousel and graphic design in **Photoshop and Canva** (again, we share files — Figma or Illustrator-only candidates aren’t a fit)

- Native or near-native English written

- Comfortable with Meta Business Suite, TikTok Business, and a scheduler (Later, Metricool, or similar)

- You watch enough cinematic/creator content to *get* the tone — your reference list should include filmmakers and DPs, not just sports highlight accounts



**Tooling note:** This is a hard requirement. We work in a shared-project-file workflow so I can jump in, tweak a cut, or finish something mid-edit. Resolve + Photoshop + Canva is non-negotiable.



**Nice to have:**



- Basic DaVinci Resolve colour panel experience (you don’t need to grade from scratch, but you should know not to break my grade)

- Resolve Fusion for motion graphics and titles

- Meta Ads Manager experience (campaign setup, custom audiences, A/B testing)

- Audio cleanup for podcast work (Fairlight, basic noise reduction, level matching)

- Lightroom for quick photo edits



**Not required but a bonus:**



- Experience with photographers or video production businesses

- TikTok creator background of your own



## How we’ll work together



- Weekly 30-min call (Mondays AEDT) to review the week and plan content drops

- **Everything runs through the Controlled Chaos Studios app** — footage delivery, project file handover, review and approval cycles, comments, and day-to-day communication. You’ll be set up with your own account.

- I’ll provide brand guide, voice examples, music license access, footage, and Photoshop/Canva templates — all inside the app. You bring the craft.



**No third-party tools required** — no Slack, Drive, Notion, 
, or WhatsApp. The CCS app handles the lot.



## Compensation



- **Trial month:** fixed fee, agreed upfront based on hours

- **Ongoing:** monthly retainer based on agreed deliverables. Open to hourly or fixed depending on your preference.

- Tell me your rate. I’d rather pay fairly for someone I can grow with than chase the cheapest option.



-----



# Paid test brief (the actual filter)



Anyone can write a good cover letter. This is how I’ll actually choose.



**The brief:**

You’ll be set up with a Controlled Chaos Studios app account containing:



- 3–4 minutes of raw BTS footage from a recent shoot (camera setup, crew at work, location b-roll)

- 1–2 minutes of finished, colour-graded hero footage from the same shoot

- 10 minutes of a recent podcast recording (video + audio)

- 5–8 BTS photos from the shoot

- A short brand voice doc



All deliverables, reviews, and comms for the test happen inside the app.



**Deliver within 5 business days, uploaded to your CCS app account:**



1. **One 20–40 second cinematic BTS Reel** cut in **DaVinci Resolve** — show off the process and the look, not just the action. Music, captions, vertical 9:16. Upload the Resolve project file (.drp) along with the exported MP4. **Do not re-grade the hero footage** — use my grade as-is and respect it.

title: Dental Biller
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a Dental Biller to help our customers improve insurance collections. This role sits at the center of the revenue cycle from submitting clean claims with proper attachments, working denials and appeals, posting payments, and chasing down outstanding A/R across a wide mix of dental payers. We work with practices across general dentistry and specialty offices, and the billers who thrive here are the ones who have seen the full payer mix and can move between contexts.



This role is a chance to help shape how we work, so we want a teammate who's curious about new tools, willing to try new approaches, and excited to help us figure out what works.



What You’ll Do



* Submit clean, complete claims with all required attachments and proper CDT coding.

* Post insurance payments and adjustments accurately against EOPs and reconcile against the PMS.

* Work aging reports to bring down outstanding AR, prioritizing by timely filing risk and dollar value.

* Work denials and appeals — gather documentation, draft correspondence, and submit appeals per our playbooks.

* Verify eligibility and benefits when needed to resolve claim issues.

* Coordinate with client practices on coding, documentation, and patient eligibility questions.

* Communicate clearly with payers, clearinghouses, and client offices to move claims to resolution.

* Work closely with our software engineering team to surface issues, fine-tune internal tools, share what’s working, and improve our platform.



What You’ll Bring



* 3+ years of dental billing experience — broad exposure across multiple practices, specialties, or payer mixes is a strong plus.

* Strong experience with major dental PMS (Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, Curve, or similar) and the ability to pick up new systems quickly.

* Strong written and verbal English communication.

* Detail-oriented and a strong, problem-solving mindset.

* Familiar with Google Workspace tools and Google Chat.

* Knowledge of and commitment to HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

* A team-player interested in improving internal systems and workflows.

* Available during US business hours.

title: Client Relationship & Operations Manager
description:
Client Relationship & Operations Manager



Full-Time Remote Position (Philippines)



Established U.S.-based home service company seeking a highly organized, proactive, and professional Client Relationship & Operations Manager to become a long-term part of a fast-growing operation.



This is NOT an entry-level virtual assistant role.



We are looking for someone capable of handling real operational responsibility, customer communication, scheduling coordination, follow-ups, organization, and administrative oversight in a fast-paced environment.



If you require constant supervision, struggle with communication, or are uncomfortable taking initiative and ownership, this role will not be a good fit.



We are looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, highly responsive, and capable of helping maintain structure and organization across multiple moving parts of the business.



## Work Schedule



* Monday through Friday

* 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

* 1-hour lunch break

* 40 hours per week



Applicants MUST be fully available during U.S. Eastern business hours.



This is a real-time operational role, not passive task work.



You are expected to remain online, responsive, and immediately available during working hours for:



* phone calls

* customer communication

* scheduling updates

* internal team coordination

* operational support

* video calls when needed



## Important Communication Requirements



Applicants must be comfortable being on camera and participating in live video calls during work hours.



There will be situations where management or field staff may initiate video calls to:



* discuss live field situations

* review projects in real time

* coordinate customer concerns

* assist crews with active jobsite decisions

* communicate face-to-face regarding operational matters



Professional appearance, communication, and comfort on camera are required for this position.



## Compensation Structure



We are looking for long-term tea
mbers, not temporary freelancers.



Compensation is performance-based with structured growth opportunities.



### Initial Evaluation Period



* Starting pay: $7–8/hour depending on experience, communication skills, and interview performance



### Performance Reviews



* 30-Day Review

* 60-Day Review

* 90-Day Review

* 120-Day Permanent Placement Review



Successful candidates who consistently demonstrate reliability, professionalism, organization, communication, and operational effectiveness will transition into a long-term permanent role earning up to $10/hour full-time, plus performance-based incentives and bonuses.



## Core Responsibilities



### Client Relationship Management



* Answer inbound phone calls professionally

* Respond to customer texts and
s quickly

* Maintain strong customer communication and follow-up

* Assist with scheduling coordination and appointment confirmations

* Handle customer concerns professionally and calmly

* Help maintain a high-end customer experience



### Operations Coordination



* Coordinate calendars, schedules, and field operations

* Organize and track ongoing tasks and follow-ups

* Maintain accurate CRM notes and customer records

* Ensure operational details do not fall through the cracks

* Help improve workflows and organization throughout the company

* Coordinate internally with staff and field crews throughout the day



### Administrative & Executive Support



* Assist management with organization and operational oversight

* Track pending items, priorities, and project updates

* Maintain structure, accountability, and communication across departments

* Help management stay organized in a fast-paced environment



### Social Media & Marketing Coordination



* Organize project photos and videos

* Assist with social media scheduling and posting

* Coordinate customer review requests

* Respond to messages and engagement when needed

* Help maintain brand consistency and online presence



## Required Qualifications



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong organizational skills

* High attention to detail

* Fast response time and communication

* Ability to multitask under pressure

* Strong customer service skills

* Comfortable on live video calls

* Professional appearance and communication

* Ability to think critically and solve problems independently

* Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment

* Ability to take ownership without constant supervision



## Preferred Experience



* Operations coordination

* Scheduling and dispatching

* CRM management

* Customer service

* Social media management

* Executive support

* Workflow and systems management

* Home service or construction industry experience is a major plus



## Important



We are building a serious operation and looking for serious professionals only.



This position is best suited for someone who enjoys:



* organization

* communication

* problem-solving

* operational structure

* improving systems

* helping businesses grow



This is NOT a passive assistant role.



We are looking for someone who can become a trusted operational asset and long-term part of the team.



## Application Instructions



To be considered, please submit ALL of the following:



1. Resume

2. 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself

3. Short video introduction

4. Internet speed test screenshot

5. Description of systems or workflows you have helped improve

6. Your experience with CRM systems, scheduling, and customer communication



In your application subject line, include the phrase:

“Structure Creates Growth”



Applications missing requested items will not be considered.

title: Student Plan Researcher, Developer & Marketing Contributor (Full-Time)
description:
Company Overview:

We are a specialized college counseling service dedicated to helping students from 8th to 12th grade prepare for and navigate the college admissions process. Our mission is to provide personalized support and guidance, ensuring that each student has a tailored plan to maximize their candidacy for top colleges and successfully complete their applications.



Position Overview:

We are looking for a highly organized, research-oriented, and creatively driven individual to help develop customized student plans and support our marketing efforts. The role spans three key areas of focus:



College Candidacy Development (8th to 11th Grade):

Conduct thorough research to identify appropriate extracurricular activities, including competitions, research opportunities, internships, and shadowing experiences for students at each grade level.

Ensure activities align with the student's academic and career interests, helping to strengthen their overall college profile.



College Applications (12th Grade):

Assist in building tailored college lists for students, taking into account their profiles, preferences, and strengths.

Create comprehensive timelines for application deadlines, required materials, and major milestones.

Support in managing and organizing the application process to ensure students stay on track.



Marketing & Content Support:

Research, draft, and publish blog posts and articles on topics relevant to college admissions, high school planning, and student success to help grow the company's online presence.

Identify and reach out to potential interviewees such as admissions professionals, educators, alumni, and current college students to develop compelling interview-based content.

Assist in managing the company's content calendar to ensure a consistent cadence of high-quality posts.

Support social media efforts by repurposing blog and research content into shareable formats across relevant platforms.

Contribute ideas for new content series, campaigns, or initiatives that align with the company's brand and mission.



Responsibilities:

Conduct online and outreach-based research on available programs, extracurriculars, and opportunities for high school students.

Create structured plans for each student based on their grade, interests, and career goals.

Track application deadlines, admissions requirements, and scholarship opportunities for a variety of colleges and universities.

Communicate and collaborate closely with college counselors to review and share customized plans for each student.

Continuously update and refine plans as new opportunities become available or as student profiles evolve.

Write, edit, and publish blog posts and other marketing content that reflect the company's expertise and voice.

Proactively reach out to potential interview subjects and manage follow-up communications to secure content contributions.

Collaborate across the team to ensure that both student plans and marketing content are aligned with overall company strategy.



Qualifications:

Strong research, writing, and organizational skills.

Familiarity with the U.S. college admissions process and extracurricular landscape for high school students.

Experience in educational counseling, content writing, or a related field is a plus.

Comfort with outreach,
ing or messaging potential interview guests, contributors, or partners.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with students, counselors, and external contacts.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and stay organized in a remote work environment.

title: WordPress Technical Specialist for Mission-Driven Pet Education Company
description:
WordPress Technical Specialist for Mission-Driven Pet Education Company



Help Us Impact 1 Million Pet Parents by 2030



Pet Summits is on a mission to help pet parents around the world give their animals longer, healthier, and happier lives.



We create online educational events that bring together leading veterinarians, pet health experts, trainers, and educators to help pet parents make better decisions for the animals they love.



Our goal is to impact 1 million pet parents by the year 2030, and we are building the team, systems, and technology to make that possible.



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented WordPress Technical Specialist who can help us keep our event websites, funnels, automations, reports, and technical systems running smoothly as well as build automations to improve what we already have. 



This is not a basic VA role. It is also not a pure programming role.



This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys working inside WordPress, Thrive Themes, funnels, forms, plugins, reports, dashboards, and automations, while also helping improve the way our systems work over time.



Why This Role Matters



Every event we run helps thousands of pet parents learn how to better care for their pets.



Your work will directly support that mission.



When a registration page works properly, more pet parents can attend.



When forms, tags, and automations are set up correctly, people receive the right
s at the right time.



When dashboards and reports are accurate, our team can make better decisions.



When systems are documented and improved, the whole company becomes stronger.



This role is about more than updating pages. It is about helping build the technical foundation that allows Pet Summits to grow and create more impact.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your main focus will be supporting the technical setup and maintenance of our online events.



This includes:



- Setting up and updating WordPress pages using Thrive Themes / Thrive Architect.



- Moving existing event pages into new event setups, including registration pages, speaker pages, thank-you pages, replay pages, and other funnel pages.



- Making sure pages are formatted correctly, mobile responsive, and ready before launch.



- Updating WordPress plugins and checking that updates do not break key pages or functionality.



- Testing forms, buttons, links, redirects, thank-you pages, registration flows, and other important user journeys.



- Making sure Kit / ConvertKit forms, tags, and integrations are connected properly.



- Testing Zapier automations and making sure data is moving correctly between tools.



- Helping create and maintain reports and dashboards for event performance.



- Creating and improving technical checklists, SOPs, and QA processes.



- Helping us improve existing systems so our event setup process becomes more reliable, scalable, and organized.



- Troubleshooting basic WordPress, plugin, page builder, form, tracking, and integration issues.



The Role Breakdown



Approximately 70% of this role will be WordPress, Thrive Themes, event page setup, plugin updates, testing, QA, reporting, and creating automations with Thinkific, Samcart, etc. 



Approximately 30% of this role will be dashboards, automations, process improvement, systems optimization, and helping us scale our infrastructure.



Tools & Skills We’re Looking For



You should be comfortable with, or able to quickly learn:



WordPress

Thrive Themes / Thrive Architect

Kit / ConvertKit

Samcart

Zapier

Google Sheets

Looker Studio or similar dashboard tools

Google Analytics

Google Tag Manager

ClickUp or similar project management tools

Basic HTML

Basic CSS

Basic understanding of PHP is a plus



You do not need to be a senior developer, but you should be technically confident, detail-oriented, and comfortable troubleshooting when something does not work.



 You’ll Be a Great Fit If You



Care about doing meaningful work.



Enjoy working with WordPress, pages, plugins, forms, funnels, and technical systems.



Are highly detail-oriented and like testing things properly before they go live.



Understand that small technical mistakes can affect registrations,
s, sales, and customer experience.



Can follow SOPs, but also suggest better ways to do things.



Communicate clearly when something is unclear, broken, delayed, or needs support.



Have a strong sense of ownership and responsibility.



Are excited to be part of a mission-driven company helping pet parents around the world.



Have a fast and stable internet connection.



## This Is Not the Right Fit If You



Only want to do design work.



Only want to do programming.



Only know basic WordPress posting and formatting.



Do not enjoy testing, checklists, details, or technical troubleshooting.



Need constant supervision to complete tasks.



Have unreliable internet.



Avoid communicating when something is delayed or unclear.



## What’s In It For You



- You’ll be part of a kind, mission-driven team doing work that genuinely helps pets and their families.

 with the subject line: "Experienced Grant Writer & AI Specialist - [Your Name]".

title: Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
Company Overview



We are a fully integrated Microsoft cloud ecosystem. To support our operational scaling, we utilize leading SaaS solutions across construction, HR, and finance - specifically Procore, ELMO, Hammertech, ProcurementPro, and SAGE. We are unifying our distributed cloud data into a centralized architecture to drive automated, real-time Power BI reporting.



---



Position Overview

· Role: Data & Analytics Engineer (Power BI & ETL Pipelines)

· Location: Remote / Hybrid (St. Ives NSW, Australia or global)

· Type: Part-time (3~6Months)

· Experience Level: Mid to Senior (3+ years in Data Engineering / BI Engineering)



Core Architectural Goal

The primary objective of this role is to extract data via REST APIs from our five core SaaS platforms, construct automated ETL/ELT pipelines, and stage this data centrally.



Note: While our current file infrastructure is centered around SharePoint, you will evaluate, architect, and deploy the optimal long-term data staging repository—whether utilizing modern SharePoint/Dataverse structures or transitioning us to a dedicated Snowflake Cloud Data Platform.



Key Responsibilities



1. Data Pipeline & ETL Development

· Design, build, and maintain automated pipelines to extract data from Procore, ELMO, Hammertech, ProcurementPro, and SAGE APIs.

· Handle various SaaS authentication protocols safely (e.g., OAuth 2.0, Bearer Tokens, API Keys).

· Clean, transform, and model raw JSON/REST responses into optimized, structured relational formats.



2. Database Architecture & Storage Management

· Set up, manage, and scale the centralized target database.

· Evaluate and implement the ideal storage design: establishing modern data lists/files inside our existing Microsoft SharePoint environment, or engineering a scalable data warehouse using Snowflake.

· Ensure optimal data indexing, partitioning, and delta tracking to manage API data volume efficiently.



3. Power BI Dashboards & Semantic Modeling

· Develop, publish, and maintain enterprise-grade Power BI reports and interactive dashboards.

· Author complex, high-performance DAX calculations and measures for business key performance indicators (KPIs).

· Establish clean, scalable star-schema data models optimized for fast cross-filtering and drill-downs.

· Configure scheduled incremental updates via the Power BI Service and gateways.



Required Skills & Qualifications

· BI Visualization: High proficiency with Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, and Power Query (M).

· API Integration: Proven experience programmatically querying REST APIs, dealing with pagination, and handling data payloads.

· Data Pipelines & Orchestration: Strong experience using integration tools to move data (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Power Automate/Logic Apps, Python, or dbt).

· SQL & Data Warehousing: Advanced SQL scripting skills and hands-on exposure to cloud data platforms like Snowflake or relational engines (SQL Server/Azure SQL).

· Microsoft Ecosystem: Strong working knowledge of the SharePoint architecture, file libraries, and Microsoft 365 permissions.



Preferred Qualifications

· Prior integration experience with Procore Analytics (Delta Sharing) or HammerTech Reporting APIs.

· Background in construction, procurement, or enterprise asset management industries.

· Experience advising small-to-midmarket organizations on when to migrate from SharePoint storage to dedicated cloud data warehouses (Snowflake).

title: AI Video Producer & Editor
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC pet health brand looking for a skilled AI video editor who can produce high-converting video ads from scratch.

This is not a basic editing role. You'll be generating complex AI B-roll, product demonstrations, health/anatomy animations, and lifestyle footage of people interacting with our product — all using AI video generation tools. You'll work directly with our creative strategist who provides scripts and creative direction, and your job is to bring those scripts to life as polished, scroll-stopping video ads.



What you'll be doing:

You'll generate AI B-roll footage including realistic scenes of people using our product at home, close-up product shots showing the product in action, medical/health animations showing internal organs and biological processes, and lifestyle footage of pet owners in everyday settings. You'll edit and composite all footage into complete direct-response video ads with transitions, text overlays, pacing, sound design, and effects. You'll produce multiple variations and formats for Meta and Google ad campaigns. You'll work from scripts and creative briefs provided by our creative strategist and turn around edits quickly — we move fast and test a high volume of creatives.



You must have:

Experience with AI video generation tools (Runway, Kling, Pika, Sora, Higgsfield, or similar — tell us which ones you use and what you've made with them). Strong traditional video editing skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro. A portfolio showing AI-generated video work — specifically B-roll, product demos, or anything involving realistic human scenes. Experience producing video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands (not just YouTube content or social media clips — we need someone who understands direct response). Ability to create medical/health-style animations or motion graphics showing organs, biological processes, or scientific concepts. Understanding of ad creative structure: hook, body, CTA, pacing for paid social.



Also goo but optional if you have:

Experience in the pet, health, or wellness niche. Familiarity with Meta Ads creative best practices. Experience working with a creative strategist or performance marketing team. Ability to generate AI voiceovers or work with AI audio tools.



Do not apply if you only do basic cuts and captions. We need someone who can generate complex AI footage and turn it into professional ad creatives.



The base pay starts at $800/mo and will go up overtime based on the results.

title: Statistics Tutor
description:
Job Title: Academic Tutor (AP Statistics)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Type: Part-Time

Reports To: Director of Academic Programs



About the Role:

Telos Prep is seeking an ethical, professional, and reliable AP Statistics Tutor based in the Philippines to join our remote team. We support U.S.-based high school students through a team-based model, where each student is guided by a Head Counselor, Essay Editor, and Subject Tutors. As a tutor, you'll provide subject-specific support to help our students strengthen their academic foundations and prepare confidently for AP (Advanced Placement) Statistics coursework and the AP exam — these are college-level classes that American high school students take to earn college credit.



What You'll Do:

- Subject-Specific Tutoring: Tutor Statistics at the AP and Honors levels (Honors = advanced high school courses), with strong working knowledge of the AP Statistics course framework — sampling, probability, and inference — and the exam format (multiple-choice plus 6 FRQs, or Free-Response Questions — the written/problem-solving portion of AP exams — including the longer "investigative task").

- Student-Centered Instruction: Use a Socratic teaching style — meaning you guide students to the answer through questions instead of lecturing at them. Explain tough concepts (e.g., sampling distributions, p-values, conditions for inference) in simple language.

- FRQ Coaching: Teach students how to set up hypotheses, check conditions, run the right procedures, and write conclusions in context, the way the AP rubric expects.

- Diagnose Before Re-Teaching: When a student loses points, figure out why — whether it's a conceptual gap, a computational mistake, or unclear written communication — before re-teaching.

- Team Collaboration: Work closely with the student's Head Counselor so your tutoring supports the student's bigger academic and college-admissions plan — not just the next test.

- Prompt, Prepared Communication: Reply to messages from students, parents, and the Telos team within 24 business hours. Prepare before every session, take clear session notes, track student progress, and raise any concerns early.



Who You Are:

- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, STEM Education, or a closely related field is required. Graduate work in statistics, data science, economics, or quantitative research is a plus.

- Tutoring Experience: Documented one-on-one experience tutoring high school students in advanced math, ideally at the AP Statistics level. Experience tutoring SAT/ACT math (the major U.S. college entrance exams), Pre-Calculus, or Calculus is a bonus.

- Tooling Fluency: Comfortable using a TI-83/84 graphing calculator (the standard calculator allowed on the AP Stats exam) and Desmos (a free online graphing/statistics tool widely used by U.S. students). Light comfort with spreadsheets, Python, or R for demonstrating concepts is a plus.

- Warm & Approachable: You come across as the kind of person a teenager actually wants to keep working with — patient, encouraging, and never intimidating.

- U.S. High School Context: Familiar with how the U.S. high school system works — including AP exams, GPA (Grade Point Average — the standard U.S. academic average, usually on a 4.0 scale), transcripts, and how American teens approach college admissions — even while based in the Philippines.

- Cross-Cultural Communication: Communicate clearly and warmly with U.S. students and parents in fluent, natural-sounding English, and stay professional across time zones.

- Mission-Aligned: Excited about Telos's team-based, mentorship-oriented, "AI-Enhanced but Human-Centered" model — not looking for a generic tutoring side gig.

- Tech-Savvy: Comfortable working in a fully remote, AI-enhanced environment, including using tools like Claude, Gemini, or NotebookLM to help prepare lessons.



Schedule & Work Environment:

- Remote Setup: This role is structured as remote (Philippines-based).

- Flexible Hours: Work hours are flexible within reason, provided all deliverables are completed on time and client communication remains timely and professional.

- Availability: Must be available to tutor U.S.-based students during their after-school hours (3:00 PM to 10:00 PM Pacific Time) and on weekends. Note: this corresponds to early morning to mid-day Philippine Time the following day.



What We Offer:

- Pay: Hourly rate

- Resources: Telos will provide the necessary software subscriptions and tools required for the role.

* Real experience managing
 Ads

* Strong understanding of tracking, pixels, conversions, and attribution

* Ability to explain your strategy clearly

* Good written English

* Good communication skills

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to report results honestly

Experience with home services, construction, remodeling, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, real estate, or local service businesses is strongly preferred.

Please do not apply if:



* You are brand new to

* You cannot explain why you are making campaign decisions

* You only know how to “boost posts”

* What budget you would start with

* How you would d

Pay

How to Apply

5. Your expected pay

If you were running ads for a bathroom remodeling company in a local market, what would your first campaign strategy be and why?

title: Advertising Compliance & Risk Lead
description:
Advertising Compliance & Risk Lead

Reports To: Founder / CEO 

Location: Remote (worldwide) 

Type: Full-time 

Experience: 3+ years 

Comp Range: Flexible for the right candidate



About the Opportunity

We operate in a high-risk direct-response marketing environment in the natural health space, targeting an older demographic. Our business is exposed to two critical risks every day: ad account shutdowns from platform policy violations, and regulatory enforcement from the FTC, FDA, and related authorities over health claims in our marketing.

We already use an AI-powered compliance system that evaluates ads, scripts, and creative against a tiered compliance framework built with legal input. What we don't have is a dedicated owner responsible for ensuring compliance consistency, improving the system, and enforcing standards across the entire marketing pipeline. That's where you come in.



The Role

You will be the single operational owner of compliance across every piece of customer-facing marketing material we produce. Every ad,
, funnel, landing page, and sales script flows through you before it reaches a customer.

This is not a legal counsel role — external attorneys handle legal interpretation. Your role is operational: you make sure our systems, workflows, and AI tools enforce compliance at scale, without becoming a bottleneck that kills marketing performance.

A core part of this role is working with AI systems and prompt engineering. You will continuously refine automated compliance checks that review high volumes of creative output. Manual review alone is not enough — automation is essential, and you'll own it.



What You Will Own

End-to-end ownership of our AI-powered compliance system and prompt logic

Continuous improvement of compliance detection accuracy and frameworks

Tiered compliance guidelines aligned with FTC, FDA, and platform policies

Pre-publication review workflows for ads,
s, funnels, landing pages, and sales copy

Monitoring platform policies across Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, and others

Tracking regulatory updates and enforcement actions (FTC, FDA, state-level guidance)

Striking the right balance between compliance safety and marketing performance



You Are the Right Fit If

You have a deep understanding of advertising compliance in health/wellness or other regulated marketing environments

You know FTC advertising guidelines cold — structure/function claims, testimonial rules, substantiation standards

You're familiar with platform advertising policies across Meta, Google, TikTok, and similar

You've managed or reviewed high-volume marketing or creative output before

You have strong, practical compliance judgment — protective without being overly restrictive

You are highly proficient with AI tools and prompt engineering (this is mandatory, not nice-to-have)

You can design, test, and iterate AI workflows for content evaluation

You have an operational mindset and strong attention to detail

You can balance compliance with business growth — you understand that a campaign that never ships is its own kind of risk



Nice to Have

Direct experience in the natural health or supplement category

Background working with direct-response marketing teams or agencies

Experience with claims substantiation processes and working with external regulatory counsel



90-Day Success

Fully audited our current AI compliance system and identified the highest-impact improvements to prompt logic and detection accuracy

Documented and stress-tested our tiered compliance framework against current FTC and FDA guidance

Established a clear pre-publication review workflow that the marketing team trusts and uses without friction

Built a monitoring cadence for platform policy changes and regulatory enforcement actions, with a system for surfacing what matters to the team

Shipped at least one measurable improvement to compliance detection accuracy while maintaining or improving marketing throughput

title: Outbound Sales Representative – Website Sales (Cold Calling)
description:
Job Type: Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week | Long-Term | Remote Schedule: Flexible (must be available during US business hours)Pay: 1.50/hour



About the Role

We run a web design business that helps local service-based companies — HVAC technicians, plumbers, electricians, roofers, landscapers, and similar trades — get online for the first time. Many of these businesses are losing customers every day simply because they have no website.

Your job is to find them, call them, and fix that.

You will research local businesses that have zero online presence, reach out by phone, and offer them a professional website at a simple, fixed price. No complicated packages. No technical jargon. Just a straightforward offer that solves a real problem for a business owner.

This is a high-volume cold calling role. We move fast, we track results daily, and we reward people who can perform.



What You Will Do

 • Prospect daily — Use Google Maps, Yelp, and similar directories to identify local service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, etc.) with no website

 • Cold call a minimum of 100 businesses per day — Reach decision-makers directly and deliver a clear, confident pitch

 • Sell a fixed-price website package — One offer, one price, easy close

 • Follow up with interested leads and guide them through a simple approval process

 • Log every call in a CRM or Google Sheet — outcome, callback time, status

 • Send a daily report with total calls made, interested leads, and closed deals



Requirements

 • Minimum 3 years of experience in IT or technology sales — website sales, SaaS, software, or digital services strongly preferred

 • Exceptional spoken English — you will be speaking with US business owners all day; you must sound natural, confident, and professional with zero hesitation

 • Proven cold calling background — you are comfortable dialing strangers, handling objections, and pushing toward a close

 • Self-managed and disciplined — this is a remote, part-time role; you will not be micromanaged but you will be held to daily targets

 • Reliable equipment — stable internet connection, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace free from background noise

 • Tech comfortable — able to use Google Sheets, a basic CRM, or a call logging tool without hand-holding



Schedule & Hours

 • 20 hours per week

 • Broken down as approximately 4 hours per day, 5 days per week

 • Must overlap with US business hours (morning or afternoon shifts preferred)



Why This Role

 • Simple product to sell — one fixed price, no confusing tiers

 • You are solving a real problem for real small business owners

 • Part-time commitment with a clear path to full-time for top performers

 • Performance bonuses available for consistently hitting and exceeding targets

 • Long-term opportunity — we are building a team, not just filling a seat



How to Apply

To be considered, your application must include all three of the following:

 1. Voice recording (required) — Record a 60–90 second audio or video of yourself giving a cold call pitch to a small business owner explaining why they need a website. Upload it to Loom (loom.com), Vocaroo (vocaroo.com), or Google Drive and paste the link in your application message. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

 2. Your resume — Highlight your sales experience, specifically any cold calling, IT sales, or digital services background



We review applications as they come in. Strong applicants will be contacted within 2–3 business days.

title: Full-Time Video Editor — Nicky Gordo Show
description:
We're hiring a full-time video editor for the Nicky Gordo Show, a fast-growing podcast hosted by Fat Nick (400% QoQ growth, sponsors include BoomBoom, Rotten Candy, Triumph Arcade).



This is not a freelance gig. This is a full-time seat on a real team that's building something. If you're good and you stay sharp, there's room to grow with us.



READ THIS FIRST — NO AI SLOP



We don't want AI-generated edits. No Opus Clip, no Submagic auto-captions, no AI auto-zoom, no AI scene detection doing the work for you. We can spot it instantly and we'll cut the trial on day one if we see it.

Every edit needs to be done by a human who watched the clip, picked the 
nt, timed the cut, and made real decisions. If your workflow is "dump the episode into an AI tool and ship what it spits out," do not apply. We're paying for taste and judgment, not for someone to babysit a tool we could run ourselves for free.

You can use AI to assist (transcription, rough cuts, captions as a starting point) but the final edit has to be yours. We'll know.



What you'll deliver every week:

20 short-form clips from Nicky Gordo Show episodes (vertical, captioned, optimized for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts). Clean cuts, punchy hooks in the first 2 seconds, on-brand pacing.

YouTube long-form audio censoring. We hand you the edited episode, you go through it and bleep/mute specific curse words so it's YouTube-monetization safe. Clean, consistent censor sound, no missed words, no awkward gaps.

10 additional short edits for Reels (TikTok + YouTube) from AB6 artist content, music videos, behind the scenes, etc.

Non-negotiables:

Available Mondays and Thursdays for weekly check-ins (we'll align on a time zone that works).

Fast turnaround. We post on a schedule and we don't miss.

You actually watch and understand the content. The Nicky Gordo Show has a specific tone — unhinged, comedic, internet-native. If you don't get it, this isn't the job for you.

Sharp ear for the audio censor pass. You need to catch every flagged word. One miss and the video gets demonetized.

You take direction but also bring ideas. If you see a 
nt in an episode that we missed, flag it.

What you need:

Strong portfolio of short-form content edited by hand (send links, not screenshots).

Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve proficiency. After Effects is a plus.

Reliable internet, reliable computer, reliable communication.

English good enough to follow nuanced creative direction and recognize curse words by ear.

How to apply:

Send a short message telling me why this job. Attach 3-5 examples of short-form edits you've done — ideally for podcasts, comedy, or music content. No generic reels. No AI-tool outputs.

If you've watched the Nicky Gordo Show before applying, mention something specific you'd cut differently or better. That moves you to the top of the pile.

title: AI UGC Creator + Social Media Operator — 10 Videos/Day | Full-Time Remote | $3,000 Growth Bonus
description:
AI UGC Creator + Social Media Operator — 10 Videos/Day | Full-Time Remote | $3,000 Growth Bonus



TL;DR — for skimmers



• The role: Make 10 short-form videos/day. Post to brand-new TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube accounts. Grow them from zero.

• Pay: $1,600 USD/month + up to $3,000 bonus — $1,000 per platform that hits 1,000 followers.

• Hard requirements: Own a Mac. Own an iPhone. Use iMessage actively. Strong video editing skills. Experience with AI tools.

• Tools: Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut Pro, Higgsfield / HeyGen / ElevenLabs, Buffer / Later / Metricool, or similar.

• Schedule: 5 days OR 7 days/week — your choice. Batch production is fine. 10 videos must auto-post every single day.

• What makes this different: You also manage the accounts. Closed-loop role: create ? post ? measure ? iterate.

• To apply: Send a 30-second sample video featuring real Mac screen-recording footage. Full requirements below.



------------------------------------------------------------



ABOUT US



We're an independently distributed Mac app in the relationship / communication space.



The product plugs into iMessage and helps people understand their texts — what they really mean, what changed, and what's going on between them.



The app name and website will be shared after we review your application.



We're launching from scratch on social. You'll inherit three brand-new accounts with ZERO followers — TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — and your job is to grow them.



You will produce 10 short-form videos per day, schedule them across all three platforms using automation tools, watch the data, and iterate.



This is a closed-loop creator role:



Make ? Schedule ? Watch Metrics ? Make More Of What Works ? Repeat



Big upside: every platform you grow to 1,000 followers earns you a $1,000 bonus on top of your base. All three = $3,000 bonus.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Creation — the bulk of your day



• Produce 10 vertical 9:16 short-form videos per day, 30–60 seconds each.

• Use AI avatar / generation tools like Higgsfield, HeyGen, Synthesia, Captions.ai, or similar to generate creator-style videos.

• Use ElevenLabs or comparable tools for voiceover.

• Use our Mac app on YOUR Mac and screen-record yourself using the app on YOUR real iMessage threads.

• Combine AI footage + Mac demo footage in Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut Pro.

• Add captions, hooks, on-screen text, and CTAs.

• Create relationship/dating/life-situation story videos that feel native to TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.



The goal is not polished corporate content.



The goal is high-volume, emotionally specific, scroll-stopping short-form content.

------------------------------------------------------------



DISTRIBUTION



You will use automation tools like Buffer, Later, Metricool, Publer, or similar to schedule and cross-post videos across:



• TikTok

• Instagram Reels

• YouTube Shorts



10 posts/day must go out every day, regardless of whether you're working that day.



You can queue however far ahead you want.



You will also:



• Write platform-specific captions

• Add hashtags

• Add pinned comments

• Track which posts perform

• Respond to basic comments

• Keep the posting queue full



The automation queue can NEVER run dry.



------------------------------------------------------------



ITERATION



This is not just a video editing job.



You are responsible for noticing what works and making more of it.



You will watch the metrics in TikTok Creator Center, Instagram Insights, and YouTube Studio:



• Views

• Watch time

• Completion rate

• Shares

• Saves

• Comments

• Click-throughs

• Trial signups, when available



Then you will adjust the next batch of videos based on the data.



If a hook works, make 10 more variations.



If a format dies, kill it.



If one story angle gets comments, lean into it.



The job is:



Create ? Post ? Measure ? Learn ? Create Better



------------------------------------------------------------



REQUIREMENTS



• You must own a Mac — MacBook or Mac desktop.

• You must own an iPhone and actively use iMessage.

• Android users — please don't apply.

• You must be comfortable screen-recording your Mac.

• You must be comfortable using real iMessage threads for product demos. You can blur names, numbers, and private details.

• Strong short-form video editing skills.

• Experience making TikToks, Reels, Shorts, UGC, social ads, or AI-generated videos.

• Experience with AI video / avatar / voiceover tools.

• Comfortable making high-volume content.

• Comfortable looking at metrics and changing direction based on performance.

• Strong English for captions, hooks, CTAs, and comments.

• Reliable queue management. 10 videos must post every day, including weekends and days off.

• Stable internet.

• Available on Google Chat from 8 PM – 10 PM US Eastern on your work days for syncs and quick feedback.



------------------------------------------------------------



NICE TO HAVE



• Experience growing a TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube account from zero.

• Experience producing relationship, dating, lifestyle, or story-based content.

• Experience marketing Apple/Mac products.

• Experience with motion graphics or kinetic typography.

• Experience with social media scheduling tools.

• Familiarity with TikTok Creator Center, Instagram Insights, and YouTube Studio.

• Familiarity with affiliate links, UTM links, or performance tracking.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT WE PAY



• Base: $1,600 USD/month, paid weekly via PayPal.

• Growth bonus: $1,000 per platform that reaches 1,000 followers.

• Platforms: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube.

• All three platforms reaching 1,000 followers = $3,000 total bonus.

• Bonus is paid immediately when each platform crosses the threshold.

------------------------------------------------------------



HOURS



You d
 how you want to work.



What matters is the output:



10 videos posted automatically per day, every day, across all three platforms.



We don't measure hours logged.



We measure:



1. Quality of the 10 daily posts

2. Consistency of posting

3. Growth toward the 1K follower bonus thresholds

4. Whether you are learning from the metrics

5. Whether winning content leads to more winning content



------------------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with:



1. Confirm you own a Mac.

Include model/year if you know it.



2. Confirm you own an iPhone and actively use iMessage.

Android users — please don't apply.



3. Send 3–5 examples of short-form videos you've edited or created.

TikTok, Reels, Shorts, UGC, AI videos, or social ads are all fine.



4. Tell us which tools you use.

Include editing tools, AI video tools, voiceover tools, and scheduling tools.



5. Send ONE 30-second sample video.



Imagine a fictional Mac app that reads your iMessage history and helps you understand what someone really means over text.



Make a UGC-style short selling that fictional app.



The video should include:



• A real Mac on screen OR a Mac screen recording

• A relationship-style hook

• A quick explanation of what the app does

• Captions or on-screen text

• A clear CTA to try/download the app



Use this hook:



“She stopped replying for 2 days. I opened this Mac app to figure out what changed.”



Use this CTA:



“Try it on your Mac.”



Any Mac app is fine for the screen recording sample — Notes, Messages, Safari, anything. We just need to see that you can make a believable Mac-based UGC video with a hook, story, and CTA.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR — HONESTLY



We want someone who can make a lot of short-form videos, learn from the numbers, and keep improving.



You do not need to be famous.



You do not need a huge personal account.



But you do need taste, speed, consistency, and the ability to spot what people actually watch.



We want someone who is close to our target customer:



A Mac and iPhone user with real relationships, real iMessage threads, and an understanding of why people overthink texts.



If you read this and think, “I can absolutely grow these accounts from zero” — apply.



If you'd rather just edit videos and let someone else worry about growth, this probably isn't your role.

title: Video Editor — YouTube & Social Media
description:
Why You Should Apply: This is a long-term role on a growing media team that values craft, gives you real creative ownership, and equips you with the tools to do your best work. If you care about the quality of what you produce and want to grow with a company that notices that, this is the role. Check out our YouTube 
 to see the kind of content you're going to be producing.



About Us

LeanScaper is the category leader in landscape industry thought leadership. We help landscape business owners build companies that work without them — through education, community, and AI-powered tools. Our media team produces YouTube content (Q&As, Podcasts, Intensives), Instagram Reels, ads, and special projects for a growing audience of landscape CEOs and operators. We are a remote-first team with Filipino editors at the core of our content factory. This is a long-term role, not a one-off project.



The Role

We’re looking for a Video Editor who can work across both long-form YouTube content and short-form social media. You’ll edit podcasts, Q&As, Reels, kinetic text ads, promos, and special projects. You won’t be doing all of these at once — you’ll be assigned to specific formats and projects at a time, with the flexibility to move across them as needed.

We’re not looking for someone who just knows the mechanics. We need someone with creative vision — the ability to look at raw footage and see what the finished piece could become. Vision, taste, and judgment matter more than flashy effects.



What You’ll Do

Edit long-form content: podcasts (~60 min), Intensives (~30–35 min), Q&As (~3–10 min)



Edit short-form content: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts — both repurposed clips and original builds (promos, kinetic text, scripted social)



Build hooks — the first 3 seconds of every piece of content are your responsibility



Handle all audio design: music selection, sound effects, mixing, and cleanup



Source your own B-roll from the internal library and in-house footage



Follow packaging playbooks for titles, descriptions, SEO tags, and quality checklists



Update the Production Tracker same-day when status changes



Deliver publish-ready assets on time, within rate card hours, and to standard on first review



You will be assigned one or two formats at a time. The full list above represents the range of content you may work on over time — not your daily workload.



What We’re Looking For

Must have: Strong English comprehension — you must fully understand the spoken content you’re editing

Creative vision — you can see what a piece could become before you start cutting

Editing range across long, medium, and short-form content

Audio design skills — music, SFX, mixing, cleanup

Personal subscriptions to Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects — these are required and must be active before you start

Portfolio showing technical polish, not just raw pacing

At least one short-form vertical example in your portfolio

Gets our attention:

Experience editing for a creator or brand YouTube channel

Can explain what makes a good hook

Willingness to work with AI tools (we use ChatGPT and Claude)

Experience with video research and B-roll sourcing

Nice to have:

Familiarity with AI generation tools in Envato or FigmaWeave

Experience with Notion and 



How We Work

Weekly check-ins via Slack to verify workload

You own your queue between check-ins — self-managing, not micromanaged

Flag blockers within 24 hours — don’t sit on problems

If you’re blocked, pivot to the next item in the lineup — there’s always work to pull

Respond to leadership on Slack within an hour during working hours

Revisions turned around within 24 hours

80%+ of your assets should pass first review with minor or no revisions

Expect frequent feedback in the first 60 days as you learn our standards



Working Expectations

Full-time contractor role, 40 hours/week

Work in your local time, but maintain a consistent schedule with a minimum of 2 hours daily overlap with PST

Attend one weekly all-media tea
eting (1 hour, during PST office hours) and one weekly 1:1 with your lead (30 minutes)

Slack is the primary communication tool — used very often, daily



Values — Who Thrives Here

You care about the work. You do a second preview before submitting — catching typos, checking audio levels. Not overworking. Just being thorough with the time you have.

You take pride in what you produce. You don’t ship work you’d be embarrassed to show.

You pursue excellence. Substandard work is not something you can live with.

You take the opportunity. LeanScaper is open to equipping you with the tools you need. Take that and push as far as you can go.



How to Apply



Find our YouTube channel (LeanScaper) and check out the content we have: 



Then, in your message, include the following:



1. A short introduction of why you should be considered for this role — 2 sentences maximum.

2. Link to your portfolio or reel. Include only samples relevant to this role and that you think will get you the position. Do not send your entire body of work.

3. Links to 3 YouTube videos you think are well-edited and 3 you think are poorly edited. For each video, explain why in 10 words or less.

4. Your expected monthly rate in USD.



Applications that do not include items 1–4 will not be reviewed.

title: Social Media Manager / Content Strategist for Fitness Coaching Brand
description:
Hiring: Remote Social Media Manager / Content Strategist + Message Outreach Support



Company: Cody Watkins Fitness

Position: Part-Time Social Media Manager

Location: Remote

Start: ASAP

Pay: Based on experience



Cody Watkins Fitness is looking for a sharp, organized, and strategic Social Media Manager to help manage daily Instagram content, content planning, scheduling, stories, and basic message outreach support.



This is not just a “make the page look active” role.



We need someone who understands that social media has a job:



Get attention ? build trust ? create demand ? drive conversations ? generate coaching opportunities.



The goal is not just views, likes, or account growth.



The goal is to attract monetizable people who are actually interested in coaching, fat loss, body composition, metabolism, and long-term results.



Main Responsibilities:



- Find content ideas/trends for 3 posts per day

- Edit short-form Reels

- Find and use trending audio

- Write or clean up captions when needed

- Schedule posts in advance

- Help create a weekly/monthly content plan

- Build in promotional content for coaching

- Plan story content that drives replies, trust, and call bookings

- Mix value, authority, social proof, personal brand, and CTA content

- Send 50+ approved starter messages per day to followers/warm audience members



Content Responsibilities:



You will help find, edit, and schedule 3 posts per day.



This includes:



- Finding relevant fitness, nutrition, fat loss, metabolism, and body composition content ideas

- Researching trends, hooks, formats, 
s, Reels, and trending audio

- Editing short-form videos/Reels

- Matching content with trending audio

- Writing or cleaning up captions

- Scheduling posts in advance

- Organizing content into a weekly/monthly calendar

- Helping create content that fits the brand voice



Content Strategy Responsibilities:



You also need to help build a content plan that does more than chase views.



The content needs to include a smart mix of:



- Value-based educational content

- Contrarian fitness/nutrition takes

- Relatable fat loss struggles

- Social proof/client wins

- Authority-building posts

- Personal brand stories

- Behind-the-scenes content

- Coaching belief-shift content

- Direct promotional posts

- Soft CTAs

- Strong CTAs

- Story sequences that drive replies

- Content designed to create qualified coaching conversations



The goal is to create content that builds trust, creates demand, and drives people toward coaching conversations.



Story Responsibilities:



You should be able to help plan daily stories that support sales, audience connection, and trust-building.



Stories may include:



- Polls

- Questions

- Client wins

- Behind-the-scenes content

- Fitness/nutrition opinions

- Soft coaching CTAs

- Direct call-booking CTAs

- Reply-based prompts

- Personal life/personality content

- Scarcity/urgency when appropriate



Stories should help move people from passive viewer to active conversation.



Message Outreach Support:



You will also help with basic Instagra
ssage outreach.



This includes sending 50+ approved starter messages per day to followers or warm audience members.



This is NOT a sales conversation role.



You are not responsible for:



- Selling in the DMs

- Qualifying leads

- Handling objections

- Booking calls

- Managing conversations

- Following up back and forth



Your job is only to send the approved first-touch message so the conversation can be started.



Once someone replies, our AI/system takes over from there.



What We’re Looking For:



The right person is:



- Experienced with Instagram Reels and short-form content

- Good at spotting trends before they are dead

- Able to edit clean, engaging videos

- Comfortable finding and using trending audio

- Strategic enough to understand content should create leads, not just likes

- Familiar with CTAs, offers, story selling, and basic content funnels

- Organized enough to plan and schedule content ahead of time

- Reliable with daily outreach tasks

- Familiar with fitness, fat loss, nutrition, or coaching content

- Able to follow directions without overcomplicating everything

- Fast, detail-oriented, and consistent



Bonus Points If You Have Experience With:



- Instagram Reels

- CapCut

- Canva

- Meta Business Suite

- Instagram scheduling tools

- GoHighLevel / Elite360

- ManyChat

- High-ticket coaching

- Fitness coaching brands

- Lead generation

- Story selling

- Content calendars

- 
-style or sarcastic health/fitness content



Brand Voice:



The Cody Watkins Fitness brand is direct, honest, sharp, and sometimes sarcastic.



We are not looking for fluffy wellness content, generic influencer motivation, or corporate fitness posts.



The brand focuses on:



- Fat loss

- Metabolism

- Body composition

- Nutrition myths

- Fitness myths

- Coaching structure

- Long-term results

- Real-world transformation

- Calling out broken diet culture and bad fitness advice



Content should be useful, scroll-stopping, and built to create trust and action.



Daily / Weekly Expectations:



- 3 scheduled posts per day

- Daily story strategy/support

- 50+ approved starter outreach messages per day

- Weekly content plan

- Trending audio/content research

- Editing and scheduling

- CTA/promotional content woven into the plan

- Content that supports coaching leads, not just engagement
